Qara Khitai.fact: In 1190, one of the Qara Khitai subject tribes surrendered to the Jin, which may have been the result of this new policy. In the early 1190s, the khan of the Keraites, Toghrul, fled to the Qara Khitai seeking military support after he was ousted by his own family.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: When no support was forthcoming, Toghrul returned to Mongolia in _____ seeking Temüjin's help
Qara Khitai.fact: When no support was forthcoming, Toghrul returned to Mongolia in 1196 seeking Temüjin's help.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Toghrul later made an alliance with the Jin, through which he received his other title, Ong Khan, in _____
Qara Khitai.fact: Toghrul later made an alliance with the Jin, through which he received his other title, Ong Khan, in 1197.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: At first they were victorious, killing and capturing many _____ soldiers, but they were surprised by an attack in the night
Qara Khitai.fact: The Qara Khitai were urged by the Khwarazm Shah Tekish (who was also in conflict with the Ghurids) not to let this slide, as the other Ghurid ruler Ghiyath al-Din Muhammad would seize Khwarazm and Transoxiana. The Qara Khitai invaded Ghurid lands around Kurzuban (around modern Taloqan).

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Tekish in turn asked the _____ for help
Qara Khitai.fact: Tekish in turn asked the Ghurids for help. As a result, Khwarazm managed to provide some manner of compensation to the Qara Khitai for their losses incurred fighting against the Ghurids, using Ghurid funds.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Tekish died in _____ and his son Muhammad II of Khwarazm started his reign as a tributary of the Qara Khitai
Qara Khitai.fact: Tekish died in 1200 and his son Muhammad II of Khwarazm started his reign as a tributary of the Qara Khitai.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The Ghurids took advantage of Tekish's death to conquer certain parts of _____, including Merv and Sarakhs, where they installed Hindu Khan, Muhammad II's nephew, as their subject
Qara Khitai.fact: The Ghurids took advantage of Tekish's death to conquer certain parts of Khorasan, including Merv and Sarakhs, where they installed Hindu Khan, Muhammad II's nephew, as their subject. Muhammad II's conflict with the Ghurids in Khorasan continued for several years.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Muhammad II's conflict with the _____ in Khorasan continued for several years
Qara Khitai.fact: The Ghurids took advantage of Tekish's death to conquer certain parts of Khorasan, including Merv and Sarakhs, where they installed Hindu Khan, Muhammad II's nephew, as their subject. Muhammad II's conflict with the Ghurids in Khorasan continued for several years.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In _____, Muhammad of Ghor attacked Khwarazm directly
Qara Khitai.fact: In 1204, Muhammad of Ghor attacked Khwarazm directly.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Muhammad II hurried back to _____ and opened the dikes and burned the meadows in an effort to slow the Ghurid advance
Qara Khitai.fact: In 1204, Muhammad of Ghor attacked Khwarazm directly. Muhammad II hurried back to Khwarazm and opened the dikes and burned the meadows in an effort to slow the Ghurid advance.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The sequence of events after the _____ retreat is unclear
Qara Khitai.fact: The Khwarazmian forces suffered a heavy defeat against the Ghurids near a canal east of Gurganj and Muhammad II fled to the Qara Khitai. The Ghurids retreated south upon receiving news of Qara Khitai reinforcements.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: This act has been attributed to solidarity between _____ leaders
Qara Khitai.fact: This act has been attributed to solidarity between Muslim leaders.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The Ghurids kept Balkh and the _____ was agreed upon as the border between the two realms
Qara Khitai.fact: The Ghurids kept Balkh and the Amu Darya was agreed upon as the border between the two realms. Plans were underway for a bridge to be built across the Amu Darya to facilitate a Ghurid invasion of Transoxiana.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Plans were underway for a bridge to be built across the _____ to facilitate a Ghurid invasion of Transoxiana
Qara Khitai.fact: The Ghurids kept Balkh and the Amu Darya was agreed upon as the border between the two realms. Plans were underway for a bridge to be built across the Amu Darya to facilitate a Ghurid invasion of Transoxiana.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In the summer of _____, the Ghurid viceroy in Balkh seized Tirmidh and destroyed a Qara Khitai army stationed there
Qara Khitai.fact: In the summer of 1205, the Ghurid viceroy in Balkh seized Tirmidh and destroyed a Qara Khitai army stationed there.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: However before any of this came to fruition, Muhammad of Ghor was killed on 13 March _____ and the Ghurid invasion came to an end
Qara Khitai.fact: However before any of this came to fruition, Muhammad of Ghor was killed on 13 March 1206 and the Ghurid invasion came to an end.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Muhammad II saw the Qara Khitai's recognition of his claims as a sign of weakness and started interfering in Transoxiana in _____ when Sanjar, son of a shield maker, revolted against local leadership
Qara Khitai.fact: Muhammad II saw the Qara Khitai's recognition of his claims as a sign of weakness and started interfering in Transoxiana in 1207 when Sanjar, son of a shield maker, revolted against local leadership in Bukhara.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In _____, Muhammad II entered Bukhara and exiled Sanjar to Khwarazm
Qara Khitai.fact: In 1207, Muhammad II entered Bukhara and exiled Sanjar to Khwarazm.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: There are accounts that _____ II was actually taken captive at one point but was not recognized and released
Qara Khitai.fact: In 1207, Muhammad II entered Bukhara and exiled Sanjar to Khwarazm. There are accounts that Muhammad II was actually taken captive at one point but was not recognized and released.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: During Muhammad II's absence, his brother _____ (viceroy in Tabaristan) and Kozli (commander in Nishapur) had tried to set themselves up as rulers of Khorasan
Qara Khitai.fact: During Muhammad II's absence, his brother Ali Shah (viceroy in Tabaristan) and Kozli (commander in Nishapur) had tried to set themselves up as rulers of Khorasan. When Muhammad II returned, Kozli fled and both he and his son were killed soon after, and Ali Shah fled to Firuzkuh.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: When Muhammad II returned, Kozli fled and both he and his son were killed soon after, and _____ fled to Firuzkuh
Qara Khitai.fact: During Muhammad II's absence, his brother Ali Shah (viceroy in Tabaristan) and Kozli (commander in Nishapur) had tried to set themselves up as rulers of Khorasan. When Muhammad II returned, Kozli fled and both he and his son were killed soon after, and Ali Shah fled to Firuzkuh.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Muhammad II restored his position in _____ by conquering Herat and Firuzkuh
Qara Khitai.fact: During Muhammad II's absence, his brother Ali Shah (viceroy in Tabaristan) and Kozli (commander in Nishapur) had tried to set themselves up as rulers of Khorasan. Muhammad II restored his position in Khorasan by conquering Herat and Firuzkuh.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In _____-9, Ali Shah was executed
Qara Khitai.fact: In 1208-9, Ali Shah was executed.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Khwarazm returned to paying tribute to the Qara Khitai in _____-10 when Muhammad II was planning a campaign against the Kipchaks
Qara Khitai.fact: Khwarazm returned to paying tribute to the Qara Khitai in 1209-10 when Muhammad II was planning a campaign against the Kipchaks.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Late in the period it expanded far to the south as the Khwarezmian Empire until it was conquered by the Mongols in _____, two years after the Qara Kitai
Qara Khitai.fact: Late in the period it expanded far to the south as the Khwarezmian Empire until it was conquered by the Mongols in 1220, two years after the Qara Kitai.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In the south the Kara-Khanid vassals were lightly held and engaged in various conflicts with each other, the _____, Khwarezm and the Gurids
Qara Khitai.fact: Late in the period it expanded far to the south as the Khwarezmian Empire until it was conquered by the Mongols in 1220, two years after the Qara Kitai. In the south the Kara-Khanid vassals were lightly held and engaged in various conflicts with each other, the Qara Kitai, Khwarezm and the Gurids.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In _____, Qocho rebelled against the Qara Khitai
Qara Khitai.fact: In 1209, Qocho rebelled against the Qara Khitai.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Genghis gave _____ his daughter in return for his attendance at court as well as a sizable tribute
Qara Khitai.fact: The Uyghur ruler, Barchuq Art Tegin, reported the incident to the Qara Khitai, but at this point individuals at Qocho had already started defecting to the Mongols. Genghis gave Barchuq his daughter in return for his attendance at court as well as a sizable tribute.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In late _____ or early 1210, when Merkit refugees arrived in Qocho, Barchuq attacked them and drove them off
Qara Khitai.fact: In late 1209 or early 1210, when Merkit refugees arrived in Qocho, Barchuq attacked them and drove them off.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: He made haste to report his loyal behaviour to _____, accompanying it with tribute
Qara Khitai.fact: When Genghis Khan's messengers arrived at Qocho, the Uyghur ruler offered his allegiance to the Mongol khan. Genghis gave Barchuq his daughter in return for his attendance at court as well as a sizable tribute.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In _____, the Uyghur Idiqut had an audience with Genghis on the Kerulen River
Qara Khitai.fact: In 1211, the Uyghur Idiqut had an audience with Genghis on the Kerulen River. However, in 1211, Kuchlug revolted, and later captured Yelü Zhilugu while the latter was hunting.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: However, in _____, Kuchlug revolted, and later captured Yelü Zhilugu while the latter was hunting
Qara Khitai.fact: In 1211, the Uyghur Idiqut had an audience with Genghis on the Kerulen River. However, in 1211, Kuchlug revolted, and later captured Yelü Zhilugu while the latter was hunting.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In _____, Genghis Khan dispatched his general Jebe to pursue Kuchlug; Kuchlug fled, but in 1218, he was finally captured and decapitated
Qara Khitai.fact: In 1216, Genghis Khan dispatched his general Jebe to pursue Kuchlug; Kuchlug fled, but in 1218, he was finally captured and decapitated.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The Mongols fully conquered the former territories of the Qara-Khitai in _____
Qara Khitai.fact: The Mongols fully conquered the former territories of the Qara-Khitai in 1220.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Many eastern _____ entered Mongol service during the conquest of the Jin dynasty
Qara Khitai.fact: Many eastern Khitans entered Mongol service during the conquest of the Jin dynasty.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Another western _____ group founded by Buraq Hajib established the Qutlugh-Khanid dynasty in Kirman as a Mongol vassal
Qara Khitai.fact: Many eastern Khitans entered Mongol service during the conquest of the Jin dynasty. Another western Khitan group set up by Buraq Hajib set up the Qutlugh-Khanid dynasty in Kirman as a Mongol vassal.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: It ceased to exist as a separate political entity during the reign of Öljaitü of the _____
Qara Khitai.fact: It ceased to exist as a separate political entity during the reign of Öljaitü of the Ilkhanate.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Khitan groups were subsequently dispersed across the _____
Qara Khitai.fact: In Central Asia, part of the Qara Khitai population was incorporated into the Mongol Empire, and some Qara Khitai troops had already joined the Mongol campaign against Kuchlug. Khitan groups were subsequently dispersed across the Mongol Empire.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: By the 14th century, many had lost a distinct _____ ethnic identity, although Khitan-derived clan names and place names survived from Afghanistan to Moldova
Qara Khitai.fact: Another western Khitan group set up by Buraq Hajib set up the Qutlugh-Khanid dynasty in Kirman as a Mongol vassal. Khitan groups were subsequently dispersed across the Mongol Empire.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: A _____ tribal group also survives in northern Kyrgyzstan
Qara Khitai.fact: A Khitay tribal group also survives in northern Kyrgyzstan.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Qara Khitai is mentioned on the Asia map of Nicolas and Guillaume Sanson of _____
Qara Khitai.fact: Qara Khitai is mentioned on the Asia map of Nicolas and Guillaume Sanson of 1669.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The late-arriving _____ also became vassals, before usurping the empire under Kuchlug
Qara Khitai.fact: The late-arriving Naimans also became vassals, before usurping the empire under Kuchlug.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The Khitan rulers inherited many administrative elements from the Liao dynasty, including the use of _____ administration and imperial trappings
Qara Khitai.fact: The Khitan rulers inherited many administrative elements from the Liao dynasty, including the use of Confucian administration and imperial trappings.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The empire also adopted the title of _____ (universal Khan)
Qara Khitai.fact: The empire also adopted the title of Gurkhan (universal Khan).

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The Khitans used the _____ calendar, maintained Chinese imperial and administrative titles, gave its emperors reign names, used Chinese-styled coins, and sent imperial seals to its vassals
Qara Khitai.fact: The Khitans used the Chinese calendar, maintained Chinese imperial and administrative titles, gave its emperors reign names, used Chinese-styled coins, and sent imperial seals to its vassals. Although most of its administrative titles were derived from Chinese, the empire also adopted local administrative titles, such as tayangyu (Turkic) and vizier.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Although most of its administrative titles were derived from _____, the empire also adopted local administrative titles, such as tayangyu (Turkic) and vizier
Qara Khitai.fact: The Khitans used the Chinese calendar, maintained Chinese imperial and administrative titles, gave its emperors reign names, used Chinese-styled coins, and sent imperial seals to its vassals. Although most of its administrative titles were derived from Chinese, the empire also adopted local administrative titles, such as tayangyu (Turkic) and vizier.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The Khitans maintained their old customs, even in _____
Qara Khitai.fact: The Khitans maintained their old customs, even in Central Asia.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: They remained nomads, adhered to their traditional dress, and maintained the religious practices followed by the Liao dynasty _____
Qara Khitai.fact: The Khitans used the Chinese calendar, maintained Chinese imperial and administrative titles, gave its emperors reign names, used Chinese-styled coins, and sent imperial seals to its vassals. The Khitans maintained their old customs, even in Central Asia.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The ruling elite tried to maintain the traditional marriages between the Yelü king clan and the _____ queen clan, and were highly reluctant to allow their princesses to marry outsiders
Qara Khitai.fact: The ruling elite tried to maintain the traditional marriages between the Yelü king clan and the Xiao queen clan, and were highly reluctant to allow their princesses to marry outsiders.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The majority of the population was sedentary, although the population suddenly became more nomadic during the end of the empire, due to the influx of _____
Qara Khitai.fact: The majority of the population was sedentary, although the population suddenly became more nomadic during the end of the empire, due to the influx of Naimans.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The majority of their subjects were _____, although a significant minority practiced Buddhism and Nestorianism
Qara Khitai.fact: The majority of their subjects were Muslims, although a significant minority practiced Buddhism and Nestorianism. Qara Khitai correspondence with the Muslims of Transoxania was wrilten in Persian and used Muslim formulas.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: After the fall of the _____ dynasty, various dynasties of non-Han ethnic origins gained prestige by portraying themselves as the legitimate dynasty of China
Qara Khitai.fact: After the fall of the Tang dynasty, various dynasties of non-Han ethnic origins gained prestige by portraying themselves as the legitimate dynasty of China.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The Chinese emperor, together with the rulers of the Turks, Arabs, India and the _____, were known to Islamic writers as the world's "five great kings"
Qara Khitai.fact: The Chinese emperor, together with the rulers of the Turks, Arabs, India and the Byzantine Romans, were known to Islamic writers as the world's "five great kings".

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Marwazī wrote that _____ was a former part of China, while Fakhr al-Dīn Mubārak Shāh defined China as part of "Turkestan", and the cities of Balāsāghūn and Kashghar were considered part of China
Qara Khitai.fact: Marwazī wrote that Transoxania was a former part of China, while Fakhr al-Dīn Mubārak Shāh defined China as part of "Turkestan", and the cities of Balāsāghūn and Kashghar were considered part of China.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Names derived from Khitai are still current in modern usage, such as the _____, Bulgarian, Uzbek and Mongolian names for China
Qara Khitai.fact: Names derived from Khitai are still current in modern usage, such as the Russian, Bulgarian, Uzbek and Mongolian names for China.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: However, the use of the name Khitai to mean "China" or "_____" by Turkic speakers within China, such as the Uyghurs, is considered pejorative by the Chinese authorities, who tried to ban it
Qara Khitai.fact: However, the use of the name Khitai to mean "China" or "Chinese" by Turkic speakers within China, such as the Uyghurs, is considered pejorative by the Chinese authorities, who tried to ban it.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The inscription of the seal is written in _____ large script and contains 20 characters
Qara Khitai.fact: The inscription of the seal is written in Khitan large script and contains 20 characters.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: As of _____ it is unclear if the same regulations on seals existed in Qara Khitai as did in imperial China and if the sizes of Western Liao seals were standardised or not
Qara Khitai.fact: As of 2020 it is unclear if the same regulations on seals existed in Qara Khitai as did in imperial China and if the sizes of Western Liao seals were standardised or not.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In 1142, Dashi sent Erbuz to _____ to pillage the province, which forced Atsiz to agree to pay 30,000 dinars annual tribute
Qara Khitai.fact: After this battle, Khwarazm became a vassal state of the Khitans. In 1142, Dashi sent Erbuz to Khwarazm to pillage the province, which forced Atsiz to agree to pay 30,000 dinars annual tribute.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Its western border was defined by the _____, but the Khitans were active in Khorasan until the 1180s while Balkh remained under their rule until 1198
Qara Khitai.fact: Its western border was defined by the Amu Darya, but the Khitans were active in Khorasan until the 1180s while Balkh remained under their rule until 1198.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In 1143, the Seljuk sultan _____ attacked Khwarazm and occupied Khorasan
Qara Khitai.fact: In 1143, the Seljuk sultan Ahmad Sanjar attacked Khwarazm and occupied Khorasan.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The Oghuz rebellion was caused by the governor of Balkh, _____, who had enlisted Oghuz support against the Ghurids in 1152
Qara Khitai.fact: The Oghuz rebellion was caused by the governor of Balkh, Amir Qumach, who had enlisted Oghuz support against the Ghurids in 1152.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In 1156, a Jin army led by _____ met with a Qara Khitan raiding group several hundred strong at Kedun
Qara Khitai.fact: In 1156, a Jin army led by Po Longdun met with a Qara Khitan raiding group several hundred strong at Kedun.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In early 1156, the _____ killed Ibrahim Tabghach Khan, the Western Karakhanid ruler of Samarkand
Qara Khitai.fact: The Qara Khitai played a key role in the conflict between their vassals: the Karluks, Karakhanids, and Khwarazm. In early 1156, the Karluks killed Ibrahim Tabghach Khan, the Western Karakhanid ruler of Samarkand.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Toghrul later made an alliance with the Jin, through which he received his other title, _____, in 1197
Qara Khitai.fact: Toghrul later made an alliance with the Jin, through which he received his other title, Ong Khan, in 1197.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In 1216, _____ dispatched his general Jebe to pursue Kuchlug; Kuchlug fled, but in 1218, he was finally captured and decapitated
Qara Khitai.fact: In 1216, Genghis Khan dispatched his general Jebe to pursue Kuchlug; Kuchlug fled, but in 1218, he was finally captured and decapitated.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In the north they bordered the _____ north of Lake Balkhash until 1175 when they retreated further south
Qara Khitai.fact: In the north they bordered the Yenisei Kyrgyz north of Lake Balkhash until 1175 when they retreated further south.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The boundary of the empire in the east is hard to define but the _____ exercised some sovereignty over the Naimans east of the Altai Mountains until 1175

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The Oghuz plundered _____, while Sanjar escaped captivity in 1156 but failed to restore his former authority

There is no evidence that the Khitans were directly involved in the conflict of Khorasan, however the Turkic leaders all paid tribute to them to gain their favor during this time.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: Sultan Shah and his mother fled _____ and Tekish was enthroned on 11 December 1172

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: In 1181, they helped him seize Merv, _____, Nasa, and Abiward
Qara Khitai.fact: In 1181, they helped him seize Merv, Sarakhs, Nasa, and Abiward.

Qara Khitai.subject: Indian Music & Fine Arts
Qara Khitai.question: The conflict between _____ and his brother Sultan Shah continued in Khorasan until 1193 when Sultan Shah died

Although Tekish took precautions to guard the Amu Darya against Qara Khitai support of his brother during the conflict, the Qara Khitai offered no further responses to the matter.
